GetDrawVersion()

Retrieves the version of the state of this osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNode. The osu.Framework.Graphics.BufferedDrawNode will only re-render if this version is greater than that of the rendered osu.Framework.Graphics.Rendering.IFrameBuffers.

protected virtual long GetDrawVersion()

Returns

long

A version representing this osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNode's state.

Remarks

By default, the osu.Framework.Graphics.BufferedDrawNode is re-rendered with every osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNode invalidation.
